messages.subject: renderImage - class attribute
parts:
Hi,

According to the renderImage page, there should be a way to specify the "class" element in the list:

Other elements such as width, height, class, and alt, can also be added to the list, and they will be used as attributes in the img object.

I would like to assign the img a class so that I can use css to float it. But doesn't seem to work. Also the Shiny - Render images in a Shiny app reference page, doesn't list the class element under the section "Structure of the returned list". Has this option been removed?

Thanks,

Fong
